prior_review_triage.note_1: Fixed: Abstract eligibility now requires dimension contribution_clarity AND source_claim, excluding scholarly_novelty_or_value. Prompt/guidance and regression enforce this.
prior_review_triage.note_2: The stated regex examples were inaccurate: 39%→73% yields both values and 20 percentage points yields 20. Added exact comparison/percentage-point checks. Missing numeric values and percent-unit mismatches reject deterministically; matching value alone still requires metric/unit semantic verification. Spelled-out quantities/ambiguous OCR remain a documented verifier limitation, not claimed deterministic proof.
prior_review_triage.note_3: Existing execution already skips the verifier if any origin evidence is ineligible, so no demonstrated runtime bypass. Added defense in depth: narrative union includes only source blocks eligible for their originating dimension/kind, with direct regression. Invalid origin references still reject the whole proposed judgment rather than silently repair it.

second_review_triage.blocking_1: Contradicted by complete _verify_support: provider and reasoning fields are added BEFORE call request_bytes computation. A new exact-boundary OpenRouter regression measures actual payload bytes, refuses bytes-1, accepts exact bytes. HttpClient uses the same json.dumps(payload).encode(utf-8).
second_review_triage.blocking_2: The review explicitly admits no direct trigger and no mutation. Inputs are locally owned plain dicts; first validation does not mutate, second validation binds the actual verifier input hash. Rechecking is deliberate fail-closed behavior. No shared external mutation path exists.
second_review_triage.blocking_3: Contradicted by complete QualityAssessment.__post_init__: the whole v2 verification check is already nested inside quality_status in {pass, insufficient}. New regression roundtrips uncertain v2 with failed execution and missing item verification unchanged.
second_review_triage.note_1: Section roles nominate candidates rather than certify inferences. Bounded inference may use explicit scope in an introduction/conclusion, preserving conceptual-paper treatment; it still requires verifier support from the actual cited content. Added introduction inference rejected by unsupported verifier regression. No reason to exclude scientifically valid scope sources purely by heading.
second_review_triage.note_2: Contradicted by numeric_mentions: available tuples contain (value, unit), including distinct k/m/b. Existing regression rejects 128K vs 128 and accepts only harmless 128K vs 128k typography. No multiplier magnitude transformation occurs.

review_5_triage.blocking_2: Rejected false narrative leak: any numeric/semantic item failure makes semantic_ok false, which replaces proposed rationale and summary. Added both numeric and semantic rejection regressions even when narrative verifier independently approves.

review_6_triage.note_1: Rejected mathematically incorrect list-slice claim. Explicit supplemental checks with 0,1,2 evidence rows show items[-2:] always contains rationale and uncertainty; unsupported numerical uncertainty is removed in each case.
review_6_triage.note_2: Rejected impossible premise for deterministic classifier: identical heading strings always yield identical section kinds. Blocks only join adjacent same-heading spans; existing grouping tests enforce it.
review_6_triage.note_3: No action requested; diagnostics retain JSONDecodeError/provider_error_envelope and fail closed.

papers.doi:10.48550/arxiv.2609.12320: Automatic scientific uncertainty with all submitted references eligible. The verifier detects a real model/metric mismatch: the proposal assigns 58.8% strict and 70.5% state-aware operation accuracy to GPT-5.4, while the cited results attribute those values to GPT-5.4-mini. It also rejects unestablished whole-paper release claims and incomplete equation support. Deterministic checks additionally produce conservative representation false negatives where percentages appear in a table header rather than next to each value, or PDF text merges adjacent values. Therefore not every numeric rejection is a substantive scientific flaw. Five supported evidence items remain operative; rejected claims and the original narrative are withheld.
papers.doi:10.48550/arxiv.2609.11060: Automatic scientific uncertainty, but the sole support error is a reproducible numeric-normalization defect: the claim says "95 percent" and both cited canonical blocks say "95%". The semantic verifier supports the claim; the deterministic checker treats bare 95 and 95% as different units. This is a pipeline false rejection, not evidence of scientific insufficiency. Eight supported items remain operative, and the withheld method claim/proposed pass are not manually repaired. All references are valid and eligible; no Abstract selection failure remains.
papers.doi:10.48550/arxiv.2609.11243: New technical grounding failure. The methodological-rigor item mixes a results-classified benchmark-construction block B0024 with two eligible appendix blocks (B0050/B0067). The results block actually describes task generation and deterministic quality filtering, so a heading-based method restriction rejects relevant body content. The verifier is skipped for the entire proposal. A separate 57.2% numeric check also lacks that literal unit-bearing value in its cited blocks. The old >20% complete-recovery claim is absent from the new proposal and operative card, and the former automatic pass is withdrawn. No scientific pass or insufficiency can be concluded from this execution.
papers.doi:10.64898/2026.09.03.749176: New body-role conflicts preserve a technical grounding failure. The method item combines an Introduction protocol description (B0013) with a Methods block (B0052), while an attributed limitation cites a Methods passage explicitly stating the time-bound scope (B0053) plus a body discussion of verification difficulty (B0048). The compatibility matrix rejects Introduction for method and Methods for attributed limitation, despite relevant content. No Abstract IDs are responsible. The verifier is skipped, so the result is unresolved technical grounding, not an adverse scientific verdict.
papers.arxiv:2601.07372: New body-role conflict preserves a technical grounding failure. The attributed limitation cites Experimental Results B0040, which explicitly says Engram-40B does not dominate Engram-27B on every task and attributes this to under-training. The limitation/source_claim rule excludes results-classified blocks; the same relevant passage could have been a candidate for inference, but relabelling the output manually is prohibited. All cited IDs exist; no Abstract ID is responsible. Verifier execution is skipped and no scientific verdict is accepted.

scientific_audit.scimmr_statement: The known unsupported numerical claim was removed from the new proposal rather than newly grounded. Neither the current operative evidence (empty after failed grounding) nor its published rationale asserts that answer accuracy exceeds complete evidence recovery by more than 20%. Sci-MMR is now technical grounding uncertainty, not pass. The historical pass and its exact old claim remain unchanged in assessment history. This satisfies removal of the known false acceptance but does not resolve Sci-MMR end to end.
scientific_audit.automatic_classification_caveat: The reported two scientific_uncertainty classifications are the unchanged normal-pipeline outputs. Grounding Agent Memory is demonstrably a normalization false rejection, so the label must not be interpreted as a substantive scientific concern. No manual status correction was made.
unresolved_pipeline_defects: The section compatibility matrix rejects substantively relevant body content under results/introduction/methods headings for some claim kinds.
Spelled percent and symbolic % are not normalized equivalently.
Unit-in-header tables and merged PDF values can trigger conservative numeric false rejection.
